Media personality and master of ceremonies, Adetola Fakorede, aka MC Rhelax, has continued to build a reputation in Nigeria’s wedding industry, drawing on more than 15 years of experience in event hosting.
Popularly known as “The Energy King”, he is recognised for combining humour, spontaneity and audience engagement to create memorable celebrations.
In a statement shared with Saturday Beats, MC Rhelax said his approach to hosting goes beyond entertaining guests, as it also involves managing the atmosphere, connecting families and ensuring that events run smoothly.
He also emphasised the importance of understanding the audience and adapting to the mood of each occasion to deliver engaging experiences.
With his focus on professionalism and entertainment, Rhelax continues to pursue opportunities to strengthen his presence in Nigeria’s event industry, particularly in wedding hosting.
Tofarati Ige, the Lifestyle Editor, has over 10 years experience in entertainment and lifestyle journalism. He is a music, film, arts and fashion critic. An author of two books, he also has interests in poetry and spoken word..
